primary_task: Prepare a meeting agenda/pre-read as a Notion page using context searched from Notion.

requirements.name: Notion
requirements.evidence: "search with `Notion:notion-search`, then fetch with `Notion:notion-fetch`" and "Draft agenda/pre-read in Notion with `Notion:notion-create-pages`"

requirements.name: codex CLI (codex mcp add notion)
requirements.evidence: "### 0) If any MCP call fails because Notion MCP is not connected, pause and set it up: `codex mcp add notion --url https://mcp.notion.com/mcp`"

requirements.name: web research for "Codex research"
requirements.evidence: "Enrich with Codex research (industry insights, benchmarks, risks)"
requirements.basis: web_search: search the public web and read result snippets

notes: Step 0 only runs if Notion is not connected; it is connected here. 'Codex research' read as the agent's own research. Step 4 is optional.
